description: The /settings/background-agents page correctly gates anonymous visitors with a clean 'Please sign in to continue' prompt. No background-agent config or run data leaks. No console errors.
expected: Anonymous visitors are prompted to sign in; no feature content is exposed.
actual: Clean sign-in gate, no leaked content, no errors.

description: Prod readiness reports 'Hosted prerequisites are configured' with all 11 categories ready (feature flag, auth, Vercel sign-in, GitHub OAuth, GitHub App, sandbox runtime, inference gateway, repo allowlist, cron secret, webhook secret, GitHub App webhooks). Background agents are fully configured in production.
expected: Readiness panel shows prod is configured for background agents.
actual: All categories ready; prod has been running real succeeded runs.

description: Prod run history shows multiple real Succeeded runs including ready_pr runs that created actual PRs (e.g. run VBbFB_81wtz-SLTTBcawB created PR #960 on dennisonbertram/synthetix, 49s duration, sandbox attributed, redaction passed). A fresh manual-test run (WJGH-zftPM4pr4N2Fx_hP) fired during the walk executed the full ready_pr path: sandbox provisioned, git context, branch prepared, mutation agent ran 3 LLM steps with tool-calls, then checks_failed intentionally (Live Proof Failure Agent). This is the strongest evidence the feature works end-to-end in prod, including the LLM agent loop.
expected: Background agents run end-to-end in prod including ready_pr output and LLM work.
actual: Multiple succeeded ready_pr runs created real PRs; fresh run did full LLM agent loop.

criterion: Run detail page renders typed failures with actionable guidance
description: The run detail page (/background-runs/{runId}) renders a proof strip (STATUS/TRIGGER/REPOSITORY/SANDBOX/PERMISSIONS/CHECKS/OUTPUT/DURATION), event context, run summary, and a live timeline. For the failed run it showed 'Run failed — checks_failed' with 'Fix CI and re-trigger' actionable guidance. No console errors.
expected: Run detail surfaces status, evidence, and next actions clearly.
actual: Clean proof strip + timeline + actionable failure guidance.

description: The Create-agent wizard Output tab shows 'Tool providers coming later. Composio is planned for v1.5.' but Composio is actually live (executor.ts Phase 5 resolves and injects Composio tools; COMPOSIO_API_KEY configured). The UI contradicts the actual capability.
expected: UI reflects that Composio tool selection is available.
actual: UI tells operators a working feature is unavailable.
suggested_fix: Update Output-tab copy; surface Composio toolkit selection (schema supports composioToolkitSlugs).

description: Clicking the Test button on an enabled agent in /settings/background-agents produced no visible feedback (no toast, no navigation, no new run). The underlying API works (curl POST /test created a run that executed end-to-end). The epic spec says successful test dispatches navigate to /background-runs/[runId].
expected: Clicking Test navigates to the new run's detail page or shows a clear toast with the run link.
actual: Silent no-op from the UI; no run created via the button.
suggested_fix: Fix the Test button onClick to call the test endpoint and navigate to the returned runId.

criterion: Details link in run history navigates to run detail
description: Clicking a 'Details' link in the Run history section of /settings/background-agents does not navigate — the page stays on the settings page. Direct URL navigation to /background-runs/{runId} works correctly, so the run detail page is healthy; the Details link click handler is broken.
actual: No navigation; stays on settings page.
suggested_fix: Fix the Details link's navigation (likely a Next.js Link onClick/routing issue).
